title: Purchases
subtitle: Till receipts, small expenses and electricity top-ups, compared month to month.

editor.title: Check the receipt
editor.checkHint: Read the lines again: automatic reading can be wrong on a crumpled or faded receipt.
editor.totalsMatch: The lines add up to the total ({{amount}}).
editor.totalsDiffer: The lines add up to {{lines}}, not to the total ({{total}}): a line may be misread or missing.

add.scanHint: Take a photo of the till receipt (2 or 3 photos if it is long).
add.electricityHint: Amount and kWh received, to follow consumption.
add.readingHint: A long receipt can take up to a minute.
add.kwhHint: The kWh are printed on the top-up receipt or text message.
add.savedReceipt: Receipt saved and added to the budget.

history.deleteConfirm: Delete this purchase ({{store}}, {{amount}})? It is removed from the budget too.

analysis.electricityCompare_one: {{count}} top-up this month. Last month: {{before}} for {{kwh}} kWh.
analysis.electricityCompare_other: {{count}} top-ups this month. Last month: {{before}} for {{kwh}} kWh.
analysis.groupHint: What is often bought at the corner shop can go into the monthly shopping.
analysis.none: No purchases over these two months.
analysis.trendHint: Average over the months with data: {{amount}}

errors.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: Reading receipts uses the AI assistant: a parent must first set it up in Settings → AI assistant.
errors.AI_DISABLED: The AI assistant is turned off in Settings.
errors.AI_UNAUTHORIZED: The AI assistant's key was refused. Check it in Settings.
errors.AI_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The AI assistant's model was not found. Choose a model that reads images.
errors.AI_UNREACHABLE: The AI assistant does not answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.AI_INVALID_RESPONSE: The receipt could not be read. Take the photo again, flat and in better light.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI provider returned an error. Check that the chosen model reads images.
errors.invalid_images: Photo not supported (3 photos at most, JPEG or PNG).
errors.photo: This photo could not be opened.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
